name: Bruno

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bruno is an Arthurian hero. His tale is the only rags-to-riches story in the Arthurian canon. He cleaned pots when he first reached Camelot. After he married Maledisant, he rose to become a landowner and knight.

okr.objective: Describe Bruno, the Arthurian hero who rose from pot-cleaner to knight.
